name: Depth cameras
short: Backends for Orbbec, Kinect, Azure Kinect and Intel RealSense depth cameras
long: Camera SDKs for the Depth Camera Input device: Orbbec (Femto Mega/Bolt, Gemini, Astra, over USB and Ethernet), Kinect v1, Kinect v2, Azure Kinect DK and Intel RealSense. One shared object per SDK, each self-contained and each exporting a single symbol, so several camera families can be used in the same session.
